{{Quote| I will show them our unbroken history of honor that yet remains. A hidden chain of proud tradition waiting to drag the unworthy down.|Heta Kol|<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance" />}}
'''Heta Kol''', a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] also referred to as [[Field Marshal/Legends|Field Marshal]] Kol, was the leader of a group of disenfranchised Mandalorians known as the [[Hidden Chain]] who opposed [[Mandalore the Avenger]] during the [[third Galactic War]].<ref name="TORweb" />

==Biography==
===Attack on the ''Spirit of Vengeance II''===
{{Quote|Why are you doing this?''"<br />"''The Mandalorian legacy. And revenge. Always revenge.|The [[Alliance Commander]] and Heta Kol|<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance" />}}
In [[3626 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|6.2}}</ref> Heta Kol launched an [[Attack on the Spirit of Vengeance II|attack]] against the Mandalorian [[Starship/Legends|ship]] the ''[[Spirit of Vengeance II]]'', with [[Clan Varad]], the [[Dar'manda]], and the [[Ash'ad]] following her into battle. Near the end of the attack, she engaged in battle with the [[Alliance Commander]] and [[Rass Ordo]], and was defeated. However, upon learning that her followers had secured the [[Clan Cadera banner|banner]] of [[Clan Cadera]], she pulled out and retreated from the fight.<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance" />

[[File:HetaKolArmor.png|thumb|left|250px|Heta Kol aboard the ''Spirit of Vengeance II'']]<!--Old color scheme, need to be updated-->
Following the battle, she met with representatives of the three groups that had joined her, which included [[Tyrus Brokenblade]], [[Bask Sunn]], and [[Durn Wynnward]], as well as a number of members from each group. Upon hearing them arguing with each other, Kol pulled out a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] and tossed it down towards Brokenblade, who caught it in his hand and prevented it from exploding, so long as he kept his hand on it. Kol claimed that they could only truly accomplish their goals if they were working together. To prove this point, she stabbed Brokenblade twice to show that they all needed to rely on each other. She then dismissed everyone to fulfill the orders given to them.<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance" />

Sometime after Darth Malgus' capture, Heta Kol met with the Hidden Chain on an unknown location and reunited with [[Ri'kan Kateen]], who brought his sister, the rogue Jedi Padawan, [[Sa'har Kateen]], to provide Heta with the help that she required for a certain task.<ref name="Digging Deeper>{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Digging Deeper|[[Carrick Station]]}}</ref>

===Showdown on Ruhnuk===
{{Quote|In Shae Vizla, I see only hypocrisy. She has driven out those who oppose her view, yet she has remade the Mandalorians into servants of anyone who pays her enough credits--no matter what they believe. Where is the honor in that?|Field Marshal Heta Kol|<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance" />}}
[[File:Heta_Kol_captures_Commander.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Heta Kol approaches the powerless Alliance Commander.]]
Heta was aware that she was being hunted by Shae Vizla and purposely left false trails and eliminated those who outlived their usefulness to her cause, which made it harder for Shae to track them down. Heta then assembled all of the Hidden Chain on Ruhnuk and had her fleet stationed on standby.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|A Rock and a Hard Place|[[Odessen]]}}</ref> Heta used Ri'kan to keep track of the various commanders guarding the signal towers<ref>{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Hidden Signals|[[Ruhnuk]]}}</ref> and revealed herself when the [[Alliance Commander]] was caught in a trap using [[Bask Sunn]]'s [[sonic disruptor]]s. Heta revealed that although she did not expect to see the Commander, her target was always Shae Vizla, and when Shae showed up, Heta suggested that Ruhnuk was a boring place and that she and Shae should fight it out, thereby giving the Hidden Chain some entertainment, which Shae gladly agreed to leaving the Commander to Ri'kan.<ref name="showdown">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Showdown on Ruhnuk|[[Ruhnuk]]}}</ref>

[[File:Heta_Kol_on_Ruhnuk.jpg|thumb|250px|left|Heta Kol makes a speech in front of the Clan Cadera banner.]]
Arriving in the arena filled by the Hidden Chain, Heta presented the [[Clan Cadera banner]] and revealed that her parents were part of the rebellion devised by [[Jicoln Cadera]] against [[Mandalore the Vindicated]], which inevitably failed and made the Mandalorians into obedient Imperial servants whilst drawing the same comparison to what [[Mandalore the Avenger]] did with the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] during the [[War against Zakuul]]. Heta then stated that the Hidden Chain were true Mandalorians, unchained by loyalty to others and warriors to the core, and then burned the Cadera banner, which she labeled the symbol of treachery and their obedience before announcing that Shae come and face her.<ref name="showdown" />

[[File:Heta_Kol_before_the_duel.jpg|thumb|250px|right|Heta Kol at the start of her duel against Shae Vizla.]]
Heta and Shae faced each other and received [[Beskar/Legends|Beskar]] blades from members of [[Clan Ha'rangir]] and began their duel, with both fighters evenly matched until Shae was hindered unexpectedly, but unknown to Heta, by Bask Sunn using a sonic disruptor. Heta was relentless and nearly defeated Shae until Shae's predicament was at an end and the latter soundly defeated the Hidden Chain leader in sight of her following, only to be interrupted by the arrival of Shae's forces in the arena and the engagements of both fleets. Heta was largely absent in the main fighting and attempted to finish off a wounded Shae, who still injured Heta, which prompted the latter to escape using an [[Eternal Empire shuttle]] with her fleet following suit.<ref name="showdown" />

[[File:Heta_Kol_after_Ruhnuk.jpg|thumb|250px|left|Heta Kol was left unsatisfied with how events on Ruhnuk had played out.]]
Upon exiting [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], Heta was unnerved by her loss at the hands of Shae despite Ri'kan's stating that their cause was not at an end, even though the loss of their base and Shae's victory salted her wounds. Heta became intrigued when Ri'kan, with Sa'har greatly disapproving, mentioned that his sister was aware of a powerful weapon that even [[Darth Malgus]] coveted, which would help their cause since Sa'har held the key to it, which prompted Heta to ask Sa'har if it was true and she did. Heta requested that Ri'kan not allow the two to be disturbed and walked with Sa'har to privately discuss the weapon.<ref name="showdown" />

===New Plan===
From Sa'har, Heta learned that [[Darth Nul's holocron]] contained blueprints for a [[Holocron Machine|machine]] capable of awakening a person's latent Force-sensitivity. Heta saw the potential of creating a Force-wielding army to use in her war, despite Sa'har insisting the machine could only reveal their connection to the Force, so Heta assumed that Sa'har would be able to train her new recruits.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Desperate Defiance|Mek-Sha}}</ref>

[[File:Heta looking hologram.jpg|thumb|250px|right|Heta Kol looks at a hologram of Nul's machine.]]
Heta Kol later assembled a meeting with the Hidden Chain to discuss the incident at Ruhnuk and how it has shaped the future of the Mandalorian civil war. Heta then mentioned that Bask Sunn betrayed her by using his sonic weapons and announced Dar'manda as their enemy and that Darth Nul's holocron would pave the road to their triumph. Heta concluded the meeting telling the others that from now on only her and Sa'har would know the full scope of the plan while the rest would only get their assignments.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Old Wounds|Odessen}}</ref>

===Aftermath===
{{Quote|And the Hidden Chain--their leader blind to all but her own desire to refashion the galaxy-- are hastening towards making Malgus' vision a reality.|[[Darth Jadus]]|<ref name="Pursuit of Ruin">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Dark Heart of the Fortress|[[Odessen]]}}</ref>}}
Following the [[Mission to Hidden Chain Ship|destruction of Nul's machine]] at the hands of the [[Alliance Commander]], the Hidden Chain fell into chaos. After learning that [[Jemala Ha'rangir]] was responsible for freeing a group of prisoners that hadn't reached her destroyed flagship, Heta hired [[Raal's Regulators]] to recapture her them, including Jemala. However, [[Darth Jadus]] faked a distress call to Jekiah Ordo, who sent the Alliance Commander and [[Akaavi Spar]] to rescue Jemala and her lover, [[Ora Nem]]. After the two defeated Raal's Regulators, Jemala informed them that Heta was somehow moving her forces through Imperial space unopposed and unchecked with the aid of an unknown benefactor. Furthermore, many of her forces were starting to doubt her capabilities and leadership, with her recent setbacks doing little to alleviate these doubts.<ref name="On the Run">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|On the Run|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> Jadus has deduced that the Hidden Chain were the unknowing pawns of [[Darth Malgus]] and are moving quickly to bring his ultimate plans into fruition. At an unknown area, Heta Kol silently observes the hologram of Nul's machine before moving on.<ref name="Pursuit of Ruin" />

===A new partnership===
[[File:Jadus contacts Heta.jpg|thumb|250px|left|Jadus contacts Heta about their partnership.]]
Heta Kol tasked the [[Hidden Chain]] to construct a full-scale replica of Nul's machine on [[Khar Shian]] nearing completion but faced the issue that it wasn't working and that [[Durn Wynnward]] assured Heta that "she" was not necessary for the machine to work only to then be interrupted by [[Ri'kan Kateen]] bringing a restrained [[Sa'har Kateen]] with him. Heta wasted no time in moving towards Ri'kan as he explained only to be knocked and beaten up by Heta who then pulled a knife to Ri'kan's throat, as Sa'har was further immobilized by her troops.<ref name="Masters Enigma">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|The Master's Enigma|The [[Enigma (research vessel)|''Enigma'']]}}</ref>

Heta berated Ri'kan that she only saw on traitor in chains and, as her most trusted Hi'bir, Ri'kan having failed spectacularly in his duty had dared to come back to Heta with having lost so much due to Ri'kan's inadequacy. Heta cut Ri'kan off and stated that she only needed victory and that it was clear that Sa'har was influencing Ri'kan's sense of priority to which Ri'kan was weak-willed thereby failing to resist it. Heta stated that once she had the holocron then she would have victory as the machine was nearly complete and after that she will provide Ri'kan a chance to prove that he is worthy of having his place in the Hidden Chain. A place that she gives him.<ref name="Masters Enigma" />

Suddenly, Heta is interrupted by a holocall from [[Darth Jadus]] asking if she was prepared to accept his offer.<ref name="Masters Enigma" />

===Final preparations===
{{Quote|This is sorcery, Field Marshal! Why are you bowing to his whims? The Sith are slavers, dishonorable, not to be trusted--that's what you told me!''"<br />"''Ne'johaa! Shut up, and step back.|Ri'kan Kateen and Heta Kol|<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />}}
[[File:Heta and Jadus.jpg|thumb|250px|right|Heta and Jadus witness Nul's machine]]
Heta, along with Darth Jadus and their both forces landed on [[Khar Shian]], where they utilised [[Naga Sadow's fortress]] to build the completed version of Darth Nul's machine. Using the newly acquired Darth Nul's holocron, [[Darth Rivix]] slowly activated the contraption. Heta hasted Darth Jadus, knowing that was the last moment they could operate without any interruptions from their many enemies, but the Sith Lord turned her down, claiming the machine is too sophisticated to proceed without caution and should be tested. The Field Marshal threatened him, hoping the machine had better work as he promised and with Jadus' orders, she told Ri'kan to bring forward his sister to the machine's seat, using her as a power source. The captured Jedi [[Tau Idair]] protested, as did Sa'har, pleading with her brother, but before he could do anything, the Sith acolytes Force-pulled the Padawan onto the seat. Rivix then activated Nul's masterpiece using a console panel.<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />

The process caused Sa'har great pain and Ri'kan pleaded with Heta to abandon the project, as it was Sith sorcery and their new partners would backstab them and do not care for the Mandalorians at all - something Heta told Ri'kan herself. She, however slapped him away and shut him down, with her guards threatening Ri'kan. Unable to see his sister suffer any more, the Twi'lek brother attacked the force field around Sa'har and unleashed a powerful Force lightning blast, which knocked down everyone around him and stopped the machine, freeing Sa'har from it. Recovering fast, the Field Marshal immediately brought Ri'kan to the ground and shot at him, but he dodged the blaster fire and knocked her down with a blade instead. With the situation out of control, Tau Idair broke free from her handcuffs and destroyed the control console, creating enough chaos for the Twi'lek siblings to escape. Heta then sent [[Shauz Farr]] after them.<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />

===Climax at Khar Shian===
{{Quote|Heta--I'm coming to end this. I'm coming for you.''"<br />"''Shae? Oh, you are a fool to come here-- I'm going to annihilate you! Your entire clan!|Shae Vizsla and Heta Kol|<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />}}
However, at that moment the Republic, Mandalorian and Eternal Alliance forces arrived at the planet's orbit, engaging the Hidden Chain and Jadus' forces, starting [[Battle of Khar Shian|the operation]] to stop Heta and Jadus' plans. As the battle in space ensued, a task force of the Alliance Commander, Lana Beniko and Theron Shan was deployed onto the surface of the planet, helping Sa'har against Farr and killing him. The Alliance trio then managed to destroy the power droid that was holding up a barrier around the fortress, which allowed the Mandalorian forces to land as well. Noticing the shield disappearing, Heta blamed it first on the technicians repairing the control panel, but then contacted [[Darz Varad]], a warrior who was deeper in the fortress to report a status update. He responded the fortress was under attack, but was cut off as Shae Vizsla's forces stabbed him through the back.<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />

Unbeknowst to Heta, Shae, her forces and Darth Malgus had already entered the fortress before the Alliance's attack. The Mandalore then mocked Heta through Darz's comm on his wrist and told her she's coming for the Field Marshal. This shocked Kol greatly, which prompted her to throw insults and threats at Vizsla, but the Mandalorian simply walked away from Darz's body, dismissing Heta's rant. Shae then ordered her team to split up and kill any Hidden Chain warrior they see, but to leave Heta for her. Heta then went on to throw some more insults at her by herself, before noticing an [[Unidentified Naga Sadow's sword|ancient black sword]] on a rack near the machine. As she approached it, ancient Sith voices started speaking to her and as she picked it up, the weapon started brimming with energy, much to her delight. She took off to confront Shae and as they watched it happen, Jadus and Rivix didn't stop her, disregarding her and instead focusing on their plans.<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />

===One final stand===
{{Quote|You started this--all of it--because you said we had lost our way. Now look at you! Wielding darjetii weapons. Licking Sith boots. The same boots that were on our necks for decades. What your parents, your clan, rebelled against. What got them killed!''"<br />"''And now that power is mine! I... have made it my own. And I will use it, and any weapon, to destroy you--|Shae Vizsla and Heta Kol|<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />}}
At the fortress power core, Shae has been killing many Hidden Chain members, when she is appraoched by the Alliance Commander and Ras and Jekiah Ordo. As they quarrelled, Heta finally located her nemesis and slowly approached her and her party, sarcastically thanking Shae for everything she had done. By bringing herself and her most important allies to one place, Heta could kill all of them at once and end the Civil War, establishing herself as the new Mandalore, all without any ticks or traps. Shae then went on a rant, pointing out that the way Heta is handling things goes against exactly what she supposedly fights and has started the entire war for - using Sith weapons instead of the traditional tactics and methods. Heta disregarded her accusations and simply said the power she has achieved is hers and will help her destroy Shae and her allies.<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />

Sliding under Heta and shooting a machine, Shae activated an electical field connecting the crystals around the power core, creating an arena. Heta shouted one final insult at her enemies, before engaging them. With the sword in her hand glowing red, Heta would attack with powers she had never had before, summoning rock formations from the ground, laser beams from the sword and encasing herself in crystal to rest mid-fight as her forces would attack in her place.

===The end of a rivalry===
{{Quote|It's over, Field Marshal''"<br />"''No...! Uhhh... Stop...! Aaah!|Shae Vizsla and Heta Kol, the latter's final words|<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />}}
Having had enough, Heta jumped up and slammed her weapon on the ground, causing a shockwave that resonated with the crystals around the arena, which soon unleashed a massive attack which shocked and paralyzed the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]], leaving the [[Alliance Commander|Commander]] barely able to stand. As she approached them, they retaliated and with that, knocked her helmet off of her head. Shockingly, Heta's face has been grotesquely transformed, with multiple rock-like tumors around her now-pale face, her eyes glowing with the same glow as her blade. Still recovering from the shock, the Commander was vulnerable as Heta approached them with her blade, ready to kill as she complimented her enemy for a fight well fought. Before she could strike them down however, Shae recovered and with her jetpack slammed Heta into a crystal, causing a massive electrical current to be sent through her body.<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />


[[File:Heta death.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Heta Kol dies]]
As she collapsed, Shae pointed her blaster at the Field Marshal and proclaimed it's over. Before she could fire her shot, however, Heta screamed in denial and ran her blade through Shae's stomach. In shock, Shae looked around herself and saw that Jekiah and the Commander are still recovering, and in an act of sacrifice, shoved herself and Heta at the crystal again. This time, she didn't release her grip and the current went through her body as well as Heta's. The Commander and Jekiah were stunned by this act, as Heta begged her rival to stop, groaning in pain. The Mandalore didn't budge at all, however, and after a moment Heta Kol stopped responding, electrocuted. As Shae let go, Heta's body hit the floor. As the glow from the blade started to disappear, the Hidden Chain's Field Marshal Heta Kol was dead.<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />

Due to the injuries she sustained courtesy of Heta, Shae passed away soon after, bringing their rivalry to a decisive and bitter end.<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:HetaKol.png|thumb|right|200px|Armor color scheme before Game Update 7.0]]
Heta Kol first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]'', as part of "Game Update 6.2: Echoes of Vengeance," released in [[2020]].<ref name="GU62">{{TORweb/Patch|6.2}}</ref> Following the release of "Game Update 7.0: Legacy of the Sith" on [[February 15]], [[2022]],<ref name="GU70">{{TORweb/Patch|7.0}}</ref> players noticed that both the armor color scheme and the voice actress of Heta Kol had changed.<ref name="Change1">{{Twitter|ShintarCommando|status/1495170927579049989|Shintar|quote=Just re-ran Spirit of Vengeance and Heta Kol changed both her colours and her voice actress! Wonder what's up with that? New actress sounds a lot more gruff and also has a very different line delivery IMO.|archivedate=20220519113139}}</ref><ref name="Change3">{{YouTube|video=XSsSi__OA5w|text=Heta Kol: Old Voice & Armor V.S. New Voice & Armor (SWTOR)|channel=channel/UChoBtMa-ICWhbqwfPO0QrdQ|name=StrangeGaming}}</ref> This change coincided with [[Melissa Medina]] announcing on [[February 17]] that she was the voice actress of Heta Kol.<ref name="Voice">{{Twitter|melissamedinavo|status/1494422049435144202|[[Melissa Medina]]|quote=I'M MADE FOR SPACE!<br />I'm officially part of the STAR WARS UNIVERSE as the badass Mandalorian Field Marshal Heta Kol in the latest @SWTOR. Find me in the Spirit of Vengeance storyline & elsewhere, defeat me if you can!<br />Thank you Darragh & everyone @bioware!|archivedate=20220219130118}}</ref>
